items.label: SCHLUMPF
items.why: the boot program: autostarts through the vector at $0326, loads HE and the fast loader with the KERNAL and starts the boot's loads; it carries the text 'TRALALA !!'

items.label: CD
items.why: the side-1 marker: unpacks to $BFC0-$BFFC with $BFEF = 1; the engine's game over ($092B) loads CD until it reads 1, to know side 1 is in the drive
the engine, packed: the game's fast loader (load_file, $6960) unpacks it to $0400-$685E
the title and hall of fame, packed: unpacks to $6C00-$C629; the boot loads it, and the engine's game over loads it again ($092B)

items.label: FT
items.why: the hero's sprites, packed: the title loads it when a game starts ($6C41), unpacking to $A000-$B5FF, and copies its 22 pages to $D000-$E5FF under the I/O chips

items.label: \A
items.why: the fast loader's computer side, loaded by the boot to $6960-$6E95; its first 672 bytes stay in the engine as load_file ($6960), and the rest is overwritten by the title once the drive code is sent

items.label: HE
items.why: the boot's own fast load routine at $0875, which the boot program calls to read the loading picture and the game's first files

items.label: IH
items.why: the high-score table, ten entries of 25 bytes, loaded raw to $6860 (the engine's high_scores); the title writes it back to side 1 with the KERNAL when a name is entered

items.label: track 8, sector 2
